label: s2_side02_0005_camera_02
text: You already got yourself 200 Pokémon from the\nTerarium?! Impressive![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_03
text: Well, look at you, putting in all that effort!\nI like to see that in a kid.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_04
text: Hahaha! Nothing, was it? All right, look at you,\nPokémon master. What a little stinker![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_05
text: You probably know more about the Pokémon in\nthe Terarium than I do—and I got here first![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_06
text: I guess you’ve earned yourself that [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]hot tip[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_07
text: Take a look at these photos, would you?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_a
text: See those strange Pokémon?\c\nThat first one’s called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Gouging Fire[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], and that\nother one’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Raging Bolt[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_b
text: See those strange Pokémon?\c\nThat first one’s called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Iron Boulder[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], and that\nother one’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Iron Crown[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_08
text: Totally unknown Pokémon in totally unknown\nplaces! If they’re real, it’d be a huge deal![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_09
text: Apparently these places are in Paldea... You have\nany idea where, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_10
text: Wow! Are they famous spots? I want to visit\nthem![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_11
text: So they aren’t somewhere you can easily reach,\nthen? Wow, these spots must be really special.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_12
text: Of course, you know how it is these days, right?\nThese photos could totally be fakes.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_13
text: But if you want to know for sure, maybe you\ncould go try to search these Pokémon out![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s2_side02_0005_camera_14
text: I can show you the photos again anytime you\nlike. Just give me a shout.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
